en.sayed-ali-raza: In the company of the Prophet of Allāh

we used to fight our parents, sons, brothers and uncles, and this continued us in our faith, in submission, in our following the right path, in endurance over the pangs of pain and in our fight against the enemy.
A man from our side and one from the enemy would pounce upon each other like energetic men contesting as to who would kill the other;
sometime our man got over his adversary and some-time the enemy’s man got over ours.
